scenes.label: Basketball court
scenes.selection_note: The central three frames give a finite projective mosaic. The full six-image sweep crosses the projective horizon in this reference frame; IMG_1241, IMG_1245, and IMG_1246 are retained locally as supplemental inputs.

annotation_provenance.method: Manual selection of human-visible landmarks by visual inspection of supplied image previews, aided by coordinate-grid enlargements. No automated feature detection or matching supplied these annotations.
annotation_provenance.notes: Rigid window mullion/transom intersections; no basketball backboard, rim, net knots, or curved net edges. Lower sill candidates were rejected after native-resolution visual inspection because net/rail occlusion made the corresponding physical edges ambiguous. Final points span the upper transom, both edges of the thick middle beam, and thin lower transom. Some intersections are partly occluded by netting. Coordinates were visually refined; no detected features or nearest-neighbor matches were used.

annotation_provenance.method: Independent visual landmark selection by the assistant on the actual source photographs; no automatic matches or projected coordinates were used as annotations.
annotation_provenance.selection_policy: Named architectural/frame corners; avoid chandelier and furniture. Pair 1247-1248 includes a farther corridor plane for broader spatial coverage; later pairs emphasize the stone wall plane.
annotation_provenance.visual_review: Numbered source/target overlays and the fitted four-image mosaic were inspected. Shared landmarks in IMG_1248 were made coordinate-consistent across pairs. No landmarks were moved to projected positions to force a lower residual.

refinement.method: Independent original-resolution visual crop review; replaced diffuse artwork shadow corners with actual gold-frame corners, corrected frame-floor and wall-floor intersections, removed chair-obscured fireplace lower-left corner. No automatic matches or H-predicted positions used. Original manual annotation record retained.
refinement.excluded_depth_plane: The two rear glazed-doorway landmarks were omitted from pair 0 because they are substantially behind both the office frame and stone wall; changing their coordinates cannot remove genuine parallax.
